description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeCountAPI endpoint in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies various behaviors of the API, such as validation rules and response correctness, especially focusing on the getAll method with different filters.

classes.name: EmployeeCountAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeCountAPI endpoint, covering validation, retrieval, and filtering logic.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete operation is not implemented and raises the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the validation rules for delete are not available or raise the expected exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create operation is not implemented for EmployeeCountAPI.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for creating an EmployeeCountAPI entity.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests the validation rules used when retrieving all employee counts with different filters.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll method's response and metadata to ensure correct count and filter handling.

methods.name: getAllDataProvider
methods.description: Data provider supplying different input scenarios and expected outputs for getAll tests.

methods.name: testGetAllWithSubunitId
methods.description: Tests the behavior when filtering employee counts by subunit ID, including subunit chain retrieval.
